card.name: FuzeX Design Review
card.description: Manages the product-design phase: navigable HTML frames, per-flow approval, and the API/component/flag contract seam for a feature, served by design-frames-service.

skills.name: List design features
skills.description: List all features currently in the design phase, with frame counts and per-flow approval state.

skills.name: Get a design feature
skills.description: Fetch one feature's manifest (build inventory, contract seam) and every frame's rendered HTML.

skills.name: Propose or revise a frame
skills.description: Create or replace one navigable HTML frame within a feature, including its acceptance notes and Playwright test hooks.

skills.name: Approve a design flow
skills.description: Approve one flow within a feature, binding the approval to the feature's current content stamp. Requires an authenticated caller (approvedBy is recorded).

skills.name: Get a design review link
skills.description: Get the public navigable review-site URL for a feature or a specific frame, for sharing with reviewers.
